title: Forestry sector reference data set up under R & M Security and Investigation (owner ruling 2026-09-16)
provider_modules_basis: Owner instruction 2026-09-16 ('yes, link R&M to TPFL and OFO'): enabling access_control on R & M creates an active Layer-1 org_module_subscriptions line at module_catalog pricing (access_control $500/month base at the time).
notes: Every fact below was read from the organisation's own public website (Bob sector-reference allowlist) on 2026-09-16; source_urls record where.
Office sites were geocoded through the app's governed LINZ path (linz-lookup address_autocomplete); geocode.match records whether the LINZ address matched the published street number exactly.

Forest blocks are Zone facets with PROVISIONAL circular fences around the LINZ NZ Gazetteer point of the same-named feature (CC-BY 4.0, gazetteer.linz.govt.nz); blocks with no gazetteer feature are created unplaced (no geometry) for the CRM boundary tool.
Company map PDFs are copyright TPFL/OFO and were not stored; only facts and source URLs are recorded.
R & M is named on both the Tasman Pine and OneFortyOne websites as their forest security / hunting-ballot provider; those two get operational service agreements. Everyone else is a CRM prospect.

organizations.name: Tasman Pine Forests Limited
organizations.account_notes: Tasman Pine Forests Ltd (TPFL), Wakefield-based subsidiary of Sumitomo Forestry NZ Ltd; forest estate of some 36,200 ha of exotic plantation across Nelson, Tasman and Marlborough (estate acquired from Hancock Forest Management, Dec 2016). Forest entry is by TPFL permit only; forest patrols and security checks are managed by R&M Security & Investigations Ltd (security@tasmanpine.co.nz); weekly hunting-block ballot is administered by R&M. Weekly Public Recreation Access Status PDF is the closure feed. Sources: /about/, /forest-access/, /forest-security/, /permit-forms/, /public-access-easements/, /legal-roads/, Forest Rules PDF (July 2024).

agreement.name: Forest security, patrols and access-permit administration — Tasman Pine Forests estate

Forest Rules (July 2024): hunting block applications via R&M Security & Investigations Ltd; after-hours incidents to R&M Security.
agreement.accepted_basis: Recorded as accepted on the owner's instruction (2026-09-16); the relationship is published by the client itself (tasmanpine.co.nz/forest-security, Forest Rules July 2024). No client portal invitation was sent.

organizations.name: OneFortyOne New Zealand
organizations.account_notes: OneFortyOne New Zealand (OFO; formerly Nelson Forests Ltd, acquired 2018 with the Kaituna Sawmill): ~80,000 ha of plantation and conservation land across Nelson, Tasman and Marlborough (Golden Downs, Rai, Manuka Island, Northbank Wairau, Kainui, Teetotal); land owned by Ngāti Toa Rangatira, Te Ātiawa o te Waka-a-Māui and Ngāti Tama ki Te Tau Ihu plus freehold. Forest access is by permit only (PAEs and special recreation areas excepted); 2026 public hunting season 3 Apr–25 Oct across 60 blocks / 45,684 ha, booking managed by R&M Security; Forest Security contact +64 27 530 6230. Fire restrictions from BUI 60, closures considered from BUI 80+. Sources: /about-us/new-zealand, /community/public-information (+ paenz, public-hunting-new-zealand, fire-safety-and-forest-access-new-zealand), /contact-us, Forest Access Policy (Public, NZ Forests, Aug 2025).
